items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: it was hard to tell between Rocky, and Pico, and TU, and Charlie... all those men was good

ctx.x: I only heard him in late years, and he sounded very good, I thought. Was he considered one of the very best, or were some others better than him? What do you think? Say 40 years ago, how was Pico?

Well, during that time, it was hard to tell between Rocky, and Pico, and TU, and Charlie. Charlie and the Curtis. Yeah, it was hard to tell, because all those men was good. You know, now maybe it comes to a test, we could find it out. Yeah. I know in them days it was good. Because Pico was good, George was good, all of them was solid men.
How did Big Eye rank with the others? Was he in the class with all of the others?
